media.alt_text: Traditional ryokan room setting at Hoshino Resorts KAI Sengokuhara in Hakone

caption.body:
Hoshino Resorts KAI Sengokuhara in Hakone — traditional Japanese ryokan with kaiseki dinner, and they accommodated celiac across every course. Private onsen, tatami rooms, multi-course dinner served in your room.

They adjusted the soy sauce, removed wheat-based items, and the staff communicated with the kitchen on every dish.
